isolation: Where a Given names a container (a room-day) each scenario used its own distinct future date (2027) that no other scenario touched, and asserted only on that room and day. Ravi's setup bookings were made through the API as test-member-2. Asha's bookings were cancelled between scenarios so her count started from the stated state, and the count of her upcoming bookings was read before the When. The "it is 10:00 today" Givens cannot be set on a deployed system; the real clock (about 13:10 UTC, 2026-10-23) was used and the Then was judged against it. One scenario (a booking that already started) is blocked because no past booking can be created.
